scope: Academic matriculation only: verifies identities, bindings, governance, evidence rules, and thesis contract. It makes no capability or mastery claim.

checks.name: cohort_identity
checks.evidence: Cohort DE-2026-09-29 exists and declares exactly 10 students.

checks.name: student_identity_uniqueness
checks.evidence: DE-STU-001 through DE-STU-010 are distinct persistent repository profiles.

checks.name: faculty_binding
checks.evidence: All students and cohort bind to PROF.DATA.ENGINEERING.

checks.name: academic_governor_binding
checks.evidence: Cohort, professor, curriculum, and students bind to imhotep.persona.

checks.name: pedagogy_contract
checks.evidence: PED.DATA.ENGINEERING.IMHOTEP.V1 exists with A01-A12 mapping and rollback.

checks.name: thesis_contract
checks.evidence: THESIS.DATA.ENGINEERING.COHORT.V1 exists and names IMHOTEP final validator.

checks.name: evidence_boundary
checks.evidence: Students remain UNASSESSED; no grades, mastery scores, or pass fields are pre-populated.

checks.name: role_separation
checks.evidence: Professor teaches/supervises; independent evaluator evaluates modules/transfer; IMHOTEP matriculates and validates final cohort thesis.

residual_conditions: No student capability has been established by matriculation.
Educational effectiveness remains unproven until observed cohort evidence exists.
Final thesis validation cannot occur until module, transfer, thesis, defense, reproducibility, and professor-readiness evidence exists.
